title: On the trajectories of the ID algorithm
abstract: arXiv:2611.25877v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The ID algorithm decides whether an interventional distribution can be computed from observational data and, when it can, returns a formula in which products, ratios and summations of conditional probabilities are nested inside one another. We study these formulas by following the trajectories of the calls of the algorithm, each of which ends with a tail (an alternation of lines 7 and 2) and an exit, and we derive two main results. First, line~4 and the exit lines fix the single outer summation of the output, while the tail forms everything inside it, both the inner summations and the ratios. Second, a ratio keeps a summation in its denominator only when a repetition of the tail is entangled, and a test of ancestry in the original graph decides, before any formula is computed, whether a topological order can be chosen so as to avoid it. We also derive a bound on the nesting depth of the output, and show a simple ``dimensional'' count t

translated_abstract: ID算法用于判定一个干预分布能否从观测数据中计算得到，并且当可以计算时，返回一个公式，其中条件概率的乘积、比率和求和彼此嵌套。我们通过追踪算法调用的轨迹来研究这些公式，每次调用都以一个尾部（第7行和第2行的交替）和一个出口结束，并由此得出两个主要结果。第一，第4行和出口行确定了输出的唯一外层求和，而尾部则构成了其中的所有内容，包括内层求和和比率。第二，仅当尾部的重复相互纠缠时，比率才会在其分母中保留一个求和，并且在计算任何公式之前，可以通过在原始图中进行祖先关系测试来判定能否选择一个拓扑排序以避免这种情况。我们还推导了输出嵌套深度的上界，并展示了一个简单的“维度”计数方法……
tldr: 本文通过追踪ID算法调用的轨迹刻画其输出公式的结构，证明外层求和由特定代码行固定、比率仅在尾部重复纠缠时保留分母求和（可通过原图中的祖先测试预先判定并用拓扑排序避免），并给出了输出嵌套深度的上界。
en_tdlr: By tracing the trajectories of the ID algorithm's calls, this paper characterizes the structure of its output formulas—showing that the outer summation is fixed by specific lines, that ratios retain a summation in the denominator only when tail repetitions are entangled (avoidable via an ancestry test in the original graph), and deriving a bound on the nesting depth of the output.
